VOL. 1 · LOCAL EDITION

LOCAL REPOSITORY VOCABULARY CHECK

Find near-match code typos before review.

Context Check compares newly introduced VS Code tokens with vocabulary already in your local repository—then explains the one character that looks out of place.

Download for VS Code
Try it with sample data
→

Free · VS Code 1.85+ · repository stays on your device

Fig. 01
One mark. Before merge.

Private by design. Reads permitted workspace files on your device.

Explainable. Shows the exact nearby project token.

Respectful. Flags a comparison, never a person.

01

THE PROOF SHEET

See what “almost” looks like.

This demo runs the same deterministic matcher as the extension. Edit either side; nothing is sent anywhere.
